description: Report the plan, rate limits, and remaining monthly request quota for the configured API key. This is the only Ktemia call that is free: it does not count against the quota, and it keeps answering after the quota is spent, so it is how you diagnose a QUOTA_EXCEEDED error and find the reset date. Call it before a long run of searches to check the budget. The quota is shared across every key on an account, so adding a key does not add requests.
name: ktemia_key_status
title: Check Ktemia plan and remaining quota
